errors.profile_needs_member: Only a member of this workspace can tell Scout how to act.
errors.compile_failed: Scout couldn't read your sentence just now. Try again in a moment, or build the rule yourself.
errors.instruction_empty: Write what you want Scout to do with your mail.
errors.instruction_too_long: Keep it to {{max}} characters: one or two sentences.
errors.instruction_has_link: Leave links out. Say which mail, and what to do with it.
errors.instruction_pasted_mail: This looks pasted from an email. Say in your own words which mail, and what to do with it.
errors.compile_unavailable: This server has no language model that may read sentences. Build the rule by hand instead.
